pidgey.name: Pidgey
pidgey.flavor: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

lillipup.name: Lillipup
lillipup.flavor: This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.

zigzagoon.name: Zigzagoon
zigzagoon.flavor: It marks its territory by rubbing its bristly fur on trees. This variety of Zigzagoon is friendlier and calmer than the kind native to Galar.

sentret.name: Sentret
sentret.flavor: This Pokémon is extremely cautious. Its supple tail is well muscled and firm to the touch.

poochyena.name: Poochyena
poochyena.flavor: It bares its large fangs and barks vigorously to try to intimidate opponents, but this is actually a manifestation of its cowardly nature.

slakoth.name: Slakoth
slakoth.flavor: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

ralts.name: Ralts
ralts.flavor: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

goldeen.name: Goldeen
goldeen.flavor: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

marill.name: Marill
marill.flavor: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

ducklett.name: Ducklett
ducklett.flavor: It's not very good at flying yet. It watches the dances of its Swanna parents to learn how to move its wings.

surskit.name: Surskit
surskit.flavor: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

deerling.name: Deerling
deerling.flavor: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In early spring, these Pokémon give off a delicate, sweet, and calming scent.

wingull.name: Wingull
wingull.flavor: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

tentacool.name: Tentacool
tentacool.flavor: When the tide goes out, dehydrated Tentacool can be found left behind on the shore.

qwilfish.name: Qwilfish
qwilfish.flavor: Be cautious if this Pokémon starts sucking in water-it will soon attack by scattering the toxic spikes that grow all over its body.

skrelp.name: Skrelp
skrelp.flavor: Skrelp evades its enemies by hiding amid drifting seaweed. It eats rotten seaweed to create its poison.

swanna.name: Swanna
swanna.flavor: Centered around its leader, the flock dances in perfect sync to strengthen its unity.

tentacruel.name: Tentacruel
tentacruel.flavor: On the rare occasions that large outbreaks of Tentacruel occur, all fish Pokémon disappear from the surrounding sea.

wurmple.name: Wurmple
wurmple.flavor: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

silcoon.name: Silcoon
silcoon.flavor: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.

cascoon.name: Cascoon
cascoon.flavor: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.

tarountula.name: Tarountula
tarountula.flavor: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

shroomish.name: Shroomish
shroomish.flavor: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

wimpod.name: Wimpod
wimpod.flavor: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

combee.name: Combee
combee.flavor: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

lotad.name: Lotad
lotad.flavor: The leaf on its head is naturally dirt repellent and will stay clean even after transporting Pokémon that are covered in mud.

seedot.name: Seedot
seedot.flavor: To expand its habitat, it pretends to be a nut so that bird Pokémon will pick it up and carry it far away.

taillow.name: Taillow
taillow.flavor: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

psyduck.name: Psyduck
psyduck.flavor: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

whismur.name: Whismur
whismur.flavor: The cry of a Whismur is over 100 decibels. If you're close to a Whismur when it lets out a cry, you'll be stuck with an all-day headache.

lickitung.name: Lickitung
lickitung.flavor: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.

jigglypuff.name: Jigglypuff
jigglypuff.flavor: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

staryu.name: Staryu
staryu.flavor: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

golduck.name: Golduck
golduck.flavor: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

horsea.name: Horsea
horsea.flavor: If attacked-even by a large enemy-Horsea effortlessly swims to safety by utilizing its well-developed dorsal fin.

luvdisc.name: Luvdisc
luvdisc.flavor: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

pelipper.name: Pelipper
pelipper.flavor: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

krabby.name: Krabby
krabby.flavor: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

frillish.name: Frillish
frillish.flavor: It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws it down to the deeps, five miles below the ocean's surface.

kingler.name: Kingler
kingler.flavor: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

remoraid.name: Remoraid
remoraid.flavor: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

tynamo.name: Tynamo
tynamo.flavor: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

blitzle.name: Blitzle
blitzle.flavor: Its heartbeat generates electricity. When Blitzle is surprised and its heart rate goes up, the voltage of its electricity also rises.

gulpin.name: Gulpin
gulpin.flavor: There is nothing its stomach can't digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.

trubbish.name: Trubbish
trubbish.flavor: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

barboach.name: Barboach
barboach.flavor: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

chinchou.name: Chinchou
chinchou.flavor: It lives in ocean depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

doduo.name: Doduo
doduo.flavor: Its twin heads have exactly the same genes and battle in perfect sync with each other.

minccino.name: Minccino
minccino.flavor: When its tail has gotten dirty from self-cleaning or from cleaning its nest, Minccino spends a whole day washing its tail in clean springwater.

solrock.name: Solrock
solrock.flavor: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

lunatone.name: Lunatone
lunatone.flavor: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

swablu.name: Swablu
swablu.flavor: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

seaking.name: Seaking
seaking.flavor: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

tatsugiri-curly.name: Tatsugiri Curly
tatsugiri-curly.flavor: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

golbat.name: Golbat
golbat.flavor: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

mawile.name: Mawile
mawile.flavor: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

frigibax.name: Frigibax
frigibax.flavor: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

zangoose.name: Zangoose
zangoose.flavor: It's Seviper's archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.

seviper.name: Seviper
seviper.flavor: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

toedscool.name: Toedscool
toedscool.flavor: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

lombre.name: Lombre
lombre.flavor: Old folklore in Kitakami tells of a mischievous child who was reborn as a Pokémon.

nuzleaf.name: Nuzleaf
nuzleaf.flavor: It leads a quiet life deep in the forest. If anything wanders into its territory, Nuzleaf will warn the intruder by sounding its grass flute.

pidgeotto.name: Pidgeotto
pidgeotto.flavor: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

spinda.name: Spinda
spinda.flavor: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Their tottering steps hinder the aim of foes.

grimer.name: Grimer
grimer.flavor: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

slugma.name: Slugma
slugma.flavor: Its lava body can cool and chip away at times, but a magma bath will heal it right up.

koffing.name: Koffing
koffing.flavor: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

bouffalant.name: Bouffalant
bouffalant.flavor: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

magby.name: Magby
magby.flavor: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, sparks leak from its mouth and nostrils.

sandshrew.name: Sandshrew
sandshrew.flavor: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

cacnea.name: Cacnea
cacnea.flavor: It prefers harsh environments, such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

baltoy.name: Baltoy
baltoy.flavor: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

aron.name: Aron
aron.flavor: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

silicobra.name: Silicobra
silicobra.flavor: Silicobra's neck pouch, which can inflate and deflate like a balloon, gets more elastic each time Silicobra sheds its skin.

hippopotas.name: Hippopotas
hippopotas.flavor: It shuts its nostrils tight, then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around 10.

makuhita.name: Makuhita
makuhita.flavor: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

numel.name: Numel
numel.flavor: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

machop.name: Machop
machop.flavor: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

sawk.name: Sawk
sawk.flavor: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it's best to quietly pass by.

throh.name: Throh
throh.flavor: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh's belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer's sweat.

torkoal.name: Torkoal
torkoal.flavor: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

salandit.name: Salandit
salandit.flavor: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

mankey.name: Mankey
mankey.flavor: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

oricorio-baile.name: Oricorio Baile
oricorio-baile.flavor: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.

vigoroth.name: Vigoroth
vigoroth.flavor: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

octillery.name: Octillery
octillery.flavor: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

mantyke.name: Mantyke
mantyke.flavor: Mantyke living in Galar seem to be somewhat sluggish. The colder waters of the seas in this region may be the cause.

tropius.name: Tropius
tropius.flavor: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

trumbeak.name: Trumbeak
trumbeak.flavor: It flies around using a hundred different cries in various ways to declare its territory to others.

cutiefly.name: Cutiefly
cutiefly.flavor: When it senses the auras of people or Pokémon who are having fun, it will draw close and give them a painful poke with its long proboscis.

magikarp.name: Magikarp
magikarp.flavor: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

carvanha.name: Carvanha
carvanha.flavor: It won't attack while it's alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.

feebas.name: Feebas
feebas.flavor: This tough Pokémon is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn't popular.

linoone.name: Linoone
linoone.flavor: Its fur is strong and supple. Shaving brushes made with shed Linoone hairs are highly prized.

nickit.name: Nickit
nickit.flavor: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

gloom.name: Gloom
gloom.flavor: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

drowzee.name: Drowzee
drowzee.flavor: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

misdreavus.name: Misdreavus
misdreavus.flavor: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

haunter.name: Haunter
haunter.flavor: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

aipom.name: Aipom
aipom.flavor: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

elgyem.name: Elgyem
elgyem.flavor: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

klefki.name: Klefki
klefki.flavor: Once it absorbs a key's metal ions, it discards the key without a second thought. However, it will hang on to keys it favors for decades.

zubat.name: Zubat
zubat.flavor: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

pansage.name: Pansage
pansage.flavor: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

spoink.name: Spoink
spoink.flavor: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

panpour.name: Panpour
panpour.flavor: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

poliwhirl.name: Poliwhirl
poliwhirl.flavor: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

whiscash.name: Whiscash
whiscash.flavor: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

wailmer.name: Wailmer
wailmer.flavor: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

alomomola.name: Alomomola
alomomola.flavor: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

poliwrath.name: Poliwrath
poliwrath.flavor: Although it's skilled in a style of dynamic swimming that uses all its muscles, for some reason it lives on dry land.

politoed.name: Politoed
politoed.flavor: If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

seel.name: Seel
seel.flavor: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

dewgong.name: Dewgong
dewgong.flavor: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's colder.

clamperl.name: Clamperl
clamperl.flavor: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

cramorant.name: Cramorant
cramorant.flavor: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They're at their most formidable when they're struggling to swallow overly large prey.

gyarados.name: Gyarados
gyarados.flavor: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

kecleon.name: Kecleon
kecleon.flavor: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

girafarig.name: Girafarig
girafarig.flavor: Though very small, the brain in its tail is still considered an important organ because it emits powerful psychic energy.

wattrel.name: Wattrel
wattrel.flavor: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

tauros.name: Tauros
tauros.flavor: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

wynaut.name: Wynaut
wynaut.flavor: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.

houndour.name: Houndour
houndour.flavor: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

fletchling.name: Fletchling
fletchling.flavor: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

torchic.name: Torchic
torchic.flavor: Torchic feels toasty warm if you hug it. It has a flame sac inside its belly, and the flames burn continuously as long as Torchic has life in it.

hoppip.name: Hoppip
hoppip.flavor: This Pokémon is blown across vast distances by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of Paldea originally came from.

bellsprout.name: Bellsprout
bellsprout.flavor: No matter what Bellsprout is doing, if it detects movement nearby, it will immediately react by reaching out with its thin vines.

heracross.name: Heracross
heracross.flavor: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

treecko.name: Treecko
treecko.flavor: The small hooks on the soles of its feet latch on to walls and ceilings, so it will never fall even while hanging upside down.

masquerain.name: Masquerain
masquerain.flavor: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction-to and fro and sideways.

finneon.name: Finneon
finneon.flavor: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

corsola.name: Corsola
corsola.flavor: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

arrokuda.name: Arrokuda
arrokuda.flavor: Arrokuda can swim quickly only in a straight line. The ones that become sluggish from overeating are the first to be targeted by flocks of Wattrel.

mudkip.name: Mudkip
mudkip.flavor: It has the power to crush large boulders into pieces. To rest, it buries itself in mud at the bottom of a river.

lapras.name: Lapras
lapras.flavor: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

shellos.name: Shellos
shellos.flavor: It used to have a shell on its back long ago. This species is closely related to Pokémon like Shellder.

cubone.name: Cubone
cubone.flavor: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

onix.name: Onix
onix.flavor: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

abra.name: Abra
abra.flavor: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra's dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

sableye.name: Sableye
sableye.flavor: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

tinkatink.name: Tinkatink
tinkatink.flavor: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

relicanth.name: Relicanth
relicanth.flavor: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

wiglett.name: Wiglett
wiglett.flavor: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

voltorb.name: Voltorb
voltorb.flavor: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

magnemite.name: Magnemite
magnemite.flavor: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

pawmi.name: Pawmi
pawmi.flavor: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

shuppet.name: Shuppet
shuppet.flavor: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

banette.name: Banette
banette.flavor: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

duskull.name: Duskull
duskull.flavor: In the dead of night, these Pokémon wander through towns in search of children, whose vital energy is a Duskull's favorite food.

greavard.name: Greavard
greavard.flavor: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

gastly.name: Gastly
gastly.flavor: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

spinarak.name: Spinarak
spinarak.flavor: Even while there are prey ensnared in its nest of spun thread, Spinarak will wait motionlessly until darkness falls.

vulpix.name: Vulpix
vulpix.flavor: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

charcadet.name: Charcadet
charcadet.flavor: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

dondozo.name: Dondozo
dondozo.flavor: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

sharpedo.name: Sharpedo
sharpedo.flavor: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.

crobat.name: Crobat
crobat.flavor: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

mightyena.name: Mightyena
mightyena.flavor: They faithfully follow the orders of their leader. Prey targeted by Mightyena is never allowed to escape the outstanding teamwork of its pursuers.

toedscruel.name: Toedscruel
toedscruel.flavor: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

beldum.name: Beldum
beldum.flavor: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

graveler.name: Graveler
graveler.flavor: A slow walker, it rolls to move. It pays no attention to any object that happens to be in its path.

dwebble.name: Dwebble
dwebble.flavor: When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon is the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.

golem.name: Golem
golem.flavor: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.

diglett.name: Diglett
diglett.flavor: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

stunfisk.name: Stunfisk
stunfisk.flavor: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

quagsire.name: Quagsire
quagsire.flavor: This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

delibird.name: Delibird
delibird.flavor: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

jynx.name: Jynx
jynx.flavor: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

cryogonal.name: Cryogonal
cryogonal.flavor: Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said that people and Pokémon who die on snowy mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

spheal.name: Spheal
spheal.flavor: This Pokémon's body is covered in blubber and impressively round. It's faster for Spheal to roll around than walk.

bergmite.name: Bergmite
bergmite.flavor: They live in mountainous regions of frigid cold. On rare occasions, they ride on the back of an Avalugg to cross seas and move to new habitats.

cetoddle.name: Cetoddle
cetoddle.flavor: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

crabrawler.name: Crabrawler
crabrawler.flavor: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

clauncher.name: Clauncher
clauncher.flavor: This Pokémon launches water by detonating gas inside its right claw. It snipes flying Pokémon.

dhelmise.name: Dhelmise
dhelmise.flavor: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

ariados.name: Ariados
ariados.flavor: A single strand of a special thread is endlessly spun out of its rear. The thread leads back to its nest.

dusclops.name: Dusclops
dusclops.flavor: Dusclops is feared because it's said to pull the soul out of anyone who gazes upon the strange movements of its hands.

claydol.name: Claydol
claydol.flavor: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

altaria.name: Altaria
altaria.flavor: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

yungoos.name: Yungoos
yungoos.flavor: Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the same path every day, searching for fresh food.

rattata.name: Rattata
rattata.flavor: It's cautious in the extreme, and its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

spearow.name: Spearow
spearow.flavor: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.

bonsly.name: Bonsly
bonsly.flavor: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

ekans.name: Ekans
ekans.flavor: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.

ledyba.name: Ledyba
ledyba.flavor: It's so timid that it can't move unless it's with a swarm. It conveys its feelings through scent.

kakuna.name: Kakuna
kakuna.flavor: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

geodude.name: Geodude
geodude.flavor: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

paras.name: Paras
paras.flavor: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

caterpie.name: Caterpie
caterpie.flavor: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

pikipek.name: Pikipek
pikipek.flavor: Using its beak to strike 16 times per second, it opens holes in even the hardest of trees.

emolga.name: Emolga
emolga.flavor: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

grubbin.name: Grubbin
grubbin.flavor: Grubbin normally live underground, but if they get unearthed by Hoothoot, they may be found gathered around electric Pokémon.

scraggy.name: Scraggy
scraggy.flavor: It stretches its saggy skin up to its neck to protect itself. Among Scraggy, individuals with saggier skin apparently garner more respect.

happiny.name: Happiny
happiny.flavor: It carries a round, white rock in its belly pouch. If it gets along well with someone, it will sometimes give that person the rock.

wooper.name: Wooper
wooper.flavor: A transparent mucous membrane covers its body. Touching it bare-handed will cause a tingling numbness.

bruxish.name: Bruxish
bruxish.flavor: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.

shellder.name: Shellder
shellder.flavor: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

bidoof.name: Bidoof
bidoof.flavor: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

sunkern.name: Sunkern
sunkern.flavor: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. Knowing it's weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.

sandygast.name: Sandygast
sandygast.flavor: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else- like a branch-in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

oddish.name: Oddish
oddish.flavor: Its scientific name is Oddium wanderus. It is said to cover distances as far as 1,000 feet when night falls, walking on its two roots.

natu.name: Natu
natu.flavor: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

munna.name: Munna
munna.flavor: Late at night, it appears beside people's pillows. As it feeds on dreams, the patterns on its body give off a faint glow.

cherubi.name: Cherubi
cherubi.flavor: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.

exeggcute.name: Exeggcute
exeggcute.flavor: If you touch one of Exeggcute's heads, mistaking it for an egg, the other heads will quickly gather and attack you in a swarm.

karrablast.name: Karrablast
karrablast.flavor: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

shelmet.name: Shelmet
shelmet.flavor: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.

dustox.name: Dustox
dustox.flavor: Dustox are nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

mudbray.name: Mudbray
mudbray.flavor: This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won't dry out even if it's exposed to the sun for a long time.

munchlax.name: Munchlax
munchlax.flavor: It needs to consume its own weight in food every day. As far as flavor is concerned, it's indifferent.

weedle.name: Weedle
weedle.flavor: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

joltik.name: Joltik
joltik.flavor: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

metapod.name: Metapod
metapod.flavor: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

zarude.name: Zarude
zarude.flavor: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

roggenrola.name: Roggenrola
roggenrola.flavor: It's as hard as steel, but apparently a long soak in water will cause it to soften a bit.

sandslash.name: Sandslash
sandslash.flavor: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.

minior-red-meteor.name: Minior Red Meteor
minior-red-meteor.flavor: This Pokémon is born in the ozone layer. It falls to the ground once the outer shell enclosing its core grows heavy.

drilbur.name: Drilbur
drilbur.flavor: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

gastrodon.name: Gastrodon
gastrodon.flavor: Its whole body is sticky with mucus. In the past, this form of Gastrodon was by far the more numerous one.

dunsparce.name: Dunsparce
dunsparce.flavor: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

togedemaru.name: Togedemaru
togedemaru.flavor: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

fomantis.name: Fomantis
fomantis.flavor: Fomantis hates having its naps interrupted. It fires off beams using energy it gathers by bathing in the sun.

solosis.name: Solosis
solosis.flavor: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.

komala.name: Komala
komala.flavor: Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.

bounsweet.name: Bounsweet
bounsweet.flavor: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled- down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

turtonator.name: Turtonator
turtonator.flavor: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.

litwick.name: Litwick
litwick.flavor: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when Litwick absorbs life-force from people or Pokémon.

salazzle.name: Salazzle
salazzle.flavor: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

jangmo-o.name: Jangmo O
jangmo-o.flavor: The scale atop its head is useful for both offense and defense. It bravely stands and faces its foes rather than turning tail, even if its foes are strong.

ledian.name: Ledian
ledian.flavor: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.

beedrill.name: Beedrill
beedrill.flavor: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

mothim.name: Mothim
mothim.flavor: It loves the nectar of flowers and steals nectar collected by Combee.

parasect.name: Parasect
parasect.flavor: Parasect is controlled by a mushroom that has grown larger than its host's body. The Pokémon scatters poisonous spores.

morelull.name: Morelull
morelull.flavor: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

charjabug.name: Charjabug
charjabug.flavor: Protected by a sturdy shell, Charjabug eats large quantities of fresh and decomposing leaf litter in order to evolve.

dewpider.name: Dewpider
dewpider.flavor: Dewpider uses sticky threads to create the water bubble that covers its head, so the bubble very rarely bursts.

shuckle.name: Shuckle
shuckle.flavor: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

kangaskhan.name: Kangaskhan
kangaskhan.flavor: Although it's carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

primeape.name: Primeape
primeape.flavor: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

oranguru.name: Oranguru
oranguru.flavor: People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.

snover.name: Snover
snover.flavor: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

snorunt.name: Snorunt
snorunt.flavor: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

smoochum.name: Smoochum
smoochum.flavor: If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty, Smoochum doesn't really seem to care.

swinub.name: Swinub
swinub.flavor: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

sneasel.name: Sneasel
sneasel.flavor: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

noctowl.name: Noctowl
noctowl.flavor: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

poliwag.name: Poliwag
poliwag.flavor: The swirl on its belly is its insides showing through the skin. It appears more clearly after Poliwag eats.

wishiwashi-solo.name: Wishiwashi Solo
wishiwashi-solo.flavor: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

passimian.name: Passimian
passimian.flavor: This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries. It won't obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls without skill.

pyukumuku.name: Pyukumuku
pyukumuku.flavor: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.

azurill.name: Azurill
azurill.flavor: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.

gumshoos.name: Gumshoos
gumshoos.flavor: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.

arbok.name: Arbok
arbok.flavor: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.

igglybuff.name: Igglybuff
igglybuff.flavor: Its body has a faintly sweet scent and is bouncy and soft. If it bounces even once, it cannot stop.

meowth.name: Meowth
meowth.flavor: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

sigilyph.name: Sigilyph
sigilyph.flavor: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

skiploom.name: Skiploom
skiploom.flavor: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon's head.

buneary.name: Buneary
buneary.flavor: If both of Buneary's ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It's a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

ponyta.name: Ponyta
ponyta.flavor: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

mareep.name: Mareep
mareep.flavor: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

snorlax.name: Snorlax
snorlax.flavor: This gluttonous Pokémon eats constantly, apart from when it's asleep. It devours nearly 900 pounds of food per day.

stufful.name: Stufful
stufful.flavor: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

nincada.name: Nincada
nincada.flavor: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

stunky.name: Stunky
stunky.flavor: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

buizel.name: Buizel
buizel.flavor: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

castform.name: Castform
castform.flavor: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

lumineon.name: Lumineon
lumineon.flavor: With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémon-its natural predators.

plusle.name: Plusle
plusle.flavor: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.

minun.name: Minun
minun.flavor: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

kirlia.name: Kirlia
kirlia.flavor: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

sudowoodo.name: Sudowoodo
sudowoodo.flavor: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

rufflet.name: Rufflet
rufflet.flavor: They pick fights indiscriminately. They grow stronger and more powerful each time they faint or are injured.

bewear.name: Bewear
bewear.flavor: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

litten.name: Litten
litten.flavor: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

rowlet.name: Rowlet
rowlet.flavor: Silently it glides, streaking toward its targets to get close to them. Before they even notice it, it begins to pelt them with vicious kicks.

popplio.name: Popplio
popplio.flavor: This Pokémon can control balloons made of water. It practices diligently so it can learn to make big balloons.

drampa.name: Drampa
drampa.flavor: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

druddigon.name: Druddigon
druddigon.flavor: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathing—it won't be able to move if its body gets too cold.

durant.name: Durant
durant.flavor: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

shinx.name: Shinx
shinx.flavor: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

abomasnow.name: Abomasnow
abomasnow.flavor: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

sealeo.name: Sealeo
sealeo.flavor: Sealeo live on top of drift ice. They go swimming when they're on the hunt, seeking out their prey by scent.

klink.name: Klink
klink.flavor: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

stantler.name: Stantler
stantler.flavor: This Pokémon apparently used to live in much harsher environments, and thus it once had stronger psychic powers than it does now.

kadabra.name: Kadabra
kadabra.flavor: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

cufant.name: Cufant
cufant.flavor: Using the pointy tip of its trunk, it carves off chunks of hard rocks to eat. It is very docile and helps people with physical labor.

cubchoo.name: Cubchoo
cubchoo.flavor: Many of this species can be found along the shorelines of cold regions. If a Cubchoo lacks dangling snot, there's a chance it is sick.

golett.name: Golett
golett.flavor: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

lairon.name: Lairon
lairon.flavor: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

pawniard.name: Pawniard
pawniard.flavor: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

foongus.name: Foongus
foongus.flavor: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

meditite.name: Meditite
meditite.flavor: It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens its inner strength through meditation.

mienfoo.name: Mienfoo
mienfoo.flavor: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

cleffa.name: Cleffa
cleffa.flavor: On late nights illuminated by shooting stars, it gazes intently skyward, as if thinking of its home.

raticate.name: Raticate
raticate.flavor: It whittles down its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder block walls.

furret.name: Furret
furret.flavor: It raises its offspring inside a long, narrow nest. Once they're old enough, it takes them outside the nest to prepare them for independence.

flaaffy.name: Flaaffy
flaaffy.flavor: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

falinks.name: Falinks
falinks.flavor: The brass, which is the one that stands at the front and issues orders, is the strongest and smartest of the six.

dreepy.name: Dreepy
dreepy.flavor: In the evening, groups of Dreepy will fly at high speeds over the ocean and poke at Pokémon in the water for fun.

toucannon.name: Toucannon
toucannon.flavor: The compressed gas in Toucannon's beak launches seeds with such force that they can shatter large boulders.

luxray.name: Luxray
luxray.flavor: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

nidorina.name: Nidorina
nidorina.flavor: The horn on its head has atrophied. It's thought that this happens so Nidorina's children won't get poked while their mother is feeding them.

nidorino.name: Nidorino
nidorino.flavor: With a horn that's harder than diamond, this Pokémon goes around shattering boulders as it searches for a moon stone.

mr-mime.name: Mr Mime
mr-mime.flavor: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.

mantine.name: Mantine
mantine.flavor: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

chatot.name: Chatot
chatot.flavor: They can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

nidoran-f.name: Nidoran F
nidoran-f.flavor: Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they'll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

pidgeot.name: Pidgeot
pidgeot.flavor: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

wormadam-plant.name: Wormadam Plant
wormadam-plant.flavor: When Burmy evolves, its cloak becomes a part of its body. Wormadam's cloak is never shed.

pikachu.name: Pikachu
pikachu.flavor: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

pinsir.name: Pinsir
pinsir.flavor: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

hoothoot.name: Hoothoot
hoothoot.flavor: Hoothoot's internal clock is precise at all times. It tilts its head in a fixed rhythm.

nidoran-m.name: Nidoran M
nidoran-m.flavor: The horn on a male Nidoran's forehead contains a powerful poison. This is a very cautious Pokémon, always straining its large ears.

glimmet.name: Glimmet
glimmet.flavor: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

clefairy.name: Clefairy
clefairy.flavor: On nights with a full moon, Clefairy gather from all over and dance. Bathing in moonlight makes them float.

carnivine.name: Carnivine
carnivine.flavor: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat its prey.

maractus.name: Maractus
maractus.flavor: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.

bramblin.name: Bramblin
bramblin.flavor: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

trapinch.name: Trapinch
trapinch.flavor: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It patiently awaits prey inside its funnel- shaped nest.

chansey.name: Chansey
chansey.flavor: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

fearow.name: Fearow
fearow.flavor: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

dugtrio.name: Dugtrio
dugtrio.flavor: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

dedenne.name: Dedenne
dedenne.flavor: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

rhyhorn.name: Rhyhorn
rhyhorn.flavor: Rhyhorn claims an area with over a six mile radius as its territory. It apparently forgets where this territory is when running, however.

nacli.name: Nacli
nacli.flavor: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

sinistea.name: Sinistea
sinistea.flavor: The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in hotels and houses.

skwovet.name: Skwovet
skwovet.flavor: It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.

greedent.name: Greedent
greedent.flavor: If it spots a berry tree, it will immediately go to gather berries without a sideways glance-even if it's in the middle of a battle.

venonat.name: Venonat
venonat.flavor: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.

venomoth.name: Venomoth
venomoth.flavor: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

volbeat.name: Volbeat
volbeat.flavor: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

illumise.name: Illumise
illumise.flavor: Illumise uses its sweet scent to guide Volbeat, having them form over 200 patterns in the night sky.

basculin-red-striped.name: Basculin Red Striped
basculin-red-striped.flavor: Its temperament is vicious and aggressive. This Pokémon is also full of vitality and can multiply rapidly before anyone notices.

shroodle.name: Shroodle
shroodle.flavor: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

maschiff.name: Maschiff
maschiff.flavor: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

heatmor.name: Heatmor
heatmor.flavor: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

muk.name: Muk
muk.flavor: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

magcargo.name: Magcargo
magcargo.flavor: This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes. It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and hardened magma.

tranquill.name: Tranquill
tranquill.flavor: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

unfezant.name: Unfezant
unfezant.flavor: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

swellow.name: Swellow
swellow.flavor: It circles the sky in search of prey and dives sharply to catch its target.

staravia.name: Staravia
staravia.flavor: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

staraptor.name: Staraptor
staraptor.flavor: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

fletchinder.name: Fletchinder
fletchinder.flavor: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

talonflame.name: Talonflame
talonflame.flavor: It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies around easily, even while carrying prey that weighs more than 220 lbs.

sunflora.name: Sunflora
sunflora.flavor: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

ditto.name: Ditto
ditto.flavor: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

kilowattrel.name: Kilowattrel
kilowattrel.flavor: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

electabuzz.name: Electabuzz
electabuzz.flavor: Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.

mareanie.name: Mareanie
mareanie.flavor: This Pokémon wanders the seaside looking for food. It often gets electric shocks from broken Pincurchin spines that it tries to eat.

cetitan.name: Cetitan
cetitan.flavor: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

luxio.name: Luxio
luxio.flavor: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

camerupt.name: Camerupt
camerupt.flavor: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

houndoom.name: Houndoom
houndoom.flavor: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

lampent.name: Lampent
lampent.flavor: Lampent appears at the moment of death and promptly absorbs the spirit as it leaves the body.

machoke.name: Machoke
machoke.flavor: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

gible.name: Gible
gible.flavor: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

flittle.name: Flittle
flittle.flavor: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

squirtle.name: Squirtle
squirtle.flavor: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It sprays a potent foam from its mouth.

veluza.name: Veluza
veluza.flavor: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

squawkabilly-green-plumage.name: Squawkabilly Green Plumage
squawkabilly-green-plumage.flavor: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

tangela.name: Tangela
tangela.flavor: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

bulbasaur.name: Bulbasaur
bulbasaur.flavor: For some time after its birth, it uses the nutrients that are packed into the seed on its back in order to grow.

charmander.name: Charmander
charmander.flavor: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

exploud.name: Exploud
exploud.flavor: In the past, people would use the loud voices of these Pokémon as a means of communication between distant cities.

hariyama.name: Hariyama
hariyama.flavor: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

seadra.name: Seadra
seadra.flavor: The male raises the young. If it is approached while caring for young, it will use its toxic spines to fend off the intruder.

nidoqueen.name: Nidoqueen
nidoqueen.flavor: Nidoqueen is better at defense than offense. With scales like armor, this Pokémon will shield its children from any kind of attack.

shiinotic.name: Shiinotic
shiinotic.flavor: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

duraludon.name: Duraludon
duraludon.flavor: Duraludon's body is comprised of a special metal that's lightweight and scratch resistant. It's also smooth, as though it was given a mirror finish.

electrode.name: Electrode
electrode.flavor: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

shedinja.name: Shedinja
shedinja.flavor: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

magneton.name: Magneton
magneton.flavor: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

azumarill.name: Azumarill
azumarill.flavor: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

unown.name: Unown
unown.flavor: Because the Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether written language or Unown came first.

kricketot.name: Kricketot
kricketot.flavor: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

starly.name: Starly
starly.flavor: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

pineco.name: Pineco
pineco.flavor: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

glameow.name: Glameow
glameow.flavor: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

budew.name: Budew
budew.flavor: The pollen it releases contains poison. If this Pokémon is raised on clean water, the poison's toxicity is increased.

pachirisu.name: Pachirisu
pachirisu.flavor: It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

drifloon.name: Drifloon
drifloon.flavor: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

elekid.name: Elekid
elekid.flavor: It loves violent thunder. The space between its horns flickers bluish white when it is charging energy.

kricketune.name: Kricketune
kricketune.flavor: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

beautifly.name: Beautifly
beautifly.flavor: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

murkrow.name: Murkrow
murkrow.flavor: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

bronzor.name: Bronzor
bronzor.flavor: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

phanpy.name: Phanpy
phanpy.flavor: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won't be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

gligar.name: Gligar
gligar.flavor: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

nosepass.name: Nosepass
nosepass.flavor: The magnet in Nosepass's nose provides an unerring compass, making this Pokémon an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

chingling.name: Chingling
chingling.flavor: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

bibarel.name: Bibarel
bibarel.flavor: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

miltank.name: Miltank
miltank.flavor: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

burmy.name: Burmy
burmy.flavor: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

floatzel.name: Floatzel
floatzel.flavor: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

roselia.name: Roselia
roselia.flavor: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

helioptile.name: Helioptile
helioptile.flavor: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.

patrat.name: Patrat
patrat.flavor: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

watchog.name: Watchog
watchog.flavor: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

pidove.name: Pidove
pidove.flavor: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

croagunk.name: Croagunk
croagunk.flavor: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

jumpluff.name: Jumpluff
jumpluff.flavor: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

purugly.name: Purugly
purugly.flavor: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

medicham.name: Medicham
medicham.flavor: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

larvesta.name: Larvesta
larvesta.flavor: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

dratini.name: Dratini
dratini.flavor: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

ivysaur.name: Ivysaur
ivysaur.flavor: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

venusaur.name: Venusaur
venusaur.flavor: While it basks in the sun, it can convert the light into energy. As a result, it is more powerful in the summertime.

charmeleon.name: Charmeleon
charmeleon.flavor: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

charizard.name: Charizard
charizard.flavor: If Charizard becomes truly angered, the flame at the tip of its tail burns in a light blue shade.

wartortle.name: Wartortle
wartortle.flavor: Wartortle's long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity, so this Pokémon is quite popular among older people.

blastoise.name: Blastoise
blastoise.flavor: It deliberately increases its body weight so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

butterfree.name: Butterfree
butterfree.flavor: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

raichu.name: Raichu
raichu.flavor: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

nidoking.name: Nidoking
nidoking.flavor: When it goes on a rampage, it's impossible to control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it's lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.

clefable.name: Clefable
clefable.flavor: Said to live in quiet, remote mountains, this type of fairy has a strong aversion to being seen.

ninetales.name: Ninetales
ninetales.flavor: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

wigglytuff.name: Wigglytuff
wigglytuff.flavor: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

vileplume.name: Vileplume
vileplume.flavor: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.

persian.name: Persian
persian.flavor: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

growlithe.name: Growlithe
growlithe.flavor: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

arcanine.name: Arcanine
arcanine.flavor: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

alakazam.name: Alakazam
alakazam.flavor: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

machamp.name: Machamp
machamp.flavor: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

weepinbell.name: Weepinbell
weepinbell.flavor: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

victreebel.name: Victreebel
victreebel.flavor: It lures prey into its mouth with a nectar-like aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.

rapidash.name: Rapidash
rapidash.flavor: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

slowpoke.name: Slowpoke
slowpoke.flavor: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

slowbro.name: Slowbro
slowbro.flavor: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

farfetchd.name: Farfetchd
farfetchd.flavor: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

dodrio.name: Dodrio
dodrio.flavor: It now has three hearts and three sets of lungs. Though it can't run as fast as Doduo, Dodrio can keep running for longer stretches of time.

cloyster.name: Cloyster
cloyster.flavor: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

gengar.name: Gengar
gengar.flavor: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

hypno.name: Hypno
hypno.flavor: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

exeggutor.name: Exeggutor
exeggutor.flavor: It is called the Walking Jungle. Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.

marowak.name: Marowak
marowak.flavor: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

hitmonlee.name: Hitmonlee
hitmonlee.flavor: At the exact moment it lands a kick on its target, Hitmonlee hardens the muscles on the sole of its foot, maximizing the power of the kick.

hitmonchan.name: Hitmonchan
hitmonchan.flavor: It corners its foes with combo punches from both sides, then finishes them off with a single straight punch launched at over 300 mph.

weezing.name: Weezing
weezing.flavor: Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting them to the highest level.

rhydon.name: Rhydon
rhydon.flavor: The horn of a Rhydon is powerful enough to crush raw diamonds. These Pokémon polish their horns by bashing them together.

starmie.name: Starmie
starmie.flavor: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

scyther.name: Scyther
scyther.flavor: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

magmar.name: Magmar
magmar.flavor: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

eevee.name: Eevee
eevee.flavor: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

vaporeon.name: Vaporeon
vaporeon.flavor: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

jolteon.name: Jolteon
jolteon.flavor: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

flareon.name: Flareon
flareon.flavor: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

porygon.name: Porygon
porygon.flavor: It is an artificial Pokémon. Since it doesn't breathe, people are excited by its potential to be useful in any environment.

omanyte.name: Omanyte
omanyte.flavor: Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.

omastar.name: Omastar
omastar.flavor: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn't move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.

kabuto.name: Kabuto
kabuto.flavor: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.

kabutops.name: Kabutops
kabutops.flavor: Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.

aerodactyl.name: Aerodactyl
aerodactyl.flavor: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

articuno.name: Articuno
articuno.flavor: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

zapdos.name: Zapdos
zapdos.flavor: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

moltres.name: Moltres
moltres.flavor: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

dragonair.name: Dragonair
dragonair.flavor: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

dragonite.name: Dragonite
dragonite.flavor: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

mewtwo.name: Mewtwo
mewtwo.flavor: Created from the DNA of Mew, this Pokémon is a dangerous combination of overwhelming power and a savage heart.

mew.name: Mew
mew.flavor: It's very intelligent and can use an incredible variety of moves. Many believe that all other Pokémon are descendants of this one.

chikorita.name: Chikorita
chikorita.flavor: It loves to bask in the sunlight. It uses the leaf on its head to seek out warm places.

bayleef.name: Bayleef
bayleef.flavor: The spicy scent that wafts from around Bayleef's neck somehow makes those who smell it want to fight.

meganium.name: Meganium
meganium.flavor: Anyone who stands beside it becomes refreshed, just as if they were soaking in the soothing atmosphere of a forest.

cyndaquil.name: Cyndaquil
cyndaquil.flavor: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

quilava.name: Quilava
quilava.flavor: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.

typhlosion.name: Typhlosion
typhlosion.flavor: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur to cause huge explosions.

totodile.name: Totodile
totodile.flavor: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

croconaw.name: Croconaw
croconaw.flavor: The tips of its fangs are slanted backward. Once those fangs clamp down, the prey has no hope of escape.

feraligatr.name: Feraligatr
feraligatr.flavor: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

lanturn.name: Lanturn
lanturn.flavor: Portions of its dorsal fin mutated, becoming the parts that glow brightly to lure prey.

pichu.name: Pichu
pichu.flavor: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.

togepi.name: Togepi
togepi.flavor: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

togetic.name: Togetic
togetic.flavor: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

xatu.name: Xatu
xatu.flavor: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

ampharos.name: Ampharos
ampharos.flavor: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

bellossom.name: Bellossom
bellossom.flavor: Due to the effects of the Sun Stone, it is now active during the daytime. It likes to dance in pools of sunlight.

yanma.name: Yanma
yanma.flavor: As Yanma surveys its territory, it periodically stops to hover in place by flapping its wings at high speeds.

espeon.name: Espeon
espeon.flavor: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.

umbreon.name: Umbreon
umbreon.flavor: When exposed to the moon's aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

slowking.name: Slowking
slowking.flavor: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

wobbuffet.name: Wobbuffet
wobbuffet.flavor: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

forretress.name: Forretress
forretress.flavor: It's usually found hanging on to a fat tree trunk. It shoots out bits of its shell when it sees action.

steelix.name: Steelix
steelix.flavor: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

snubbull.name: Snubbull
snubbull.flavor: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

granbull.name: Granbull
granbull.flavor: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it desperately flails its limbs about in an attempt to repel its opponent.

scizor.name: Scizor
scizor.flavor: This Pokémon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

teddiursa.name: Teddiursa
teddiursa.flavor: This Pokémon discreetly follows Combee to find their hive. It scoops up big dollops of honey in its palms to eat.

ursaring.name: Ursaring
ursaring.flavor: It usually wears a hardened expression, but when it's licking up honey-which it loves-the joy it feels will cause it to break into a wide grin.

piloswine.name: Piloswine
piloswine.flavor: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

skarmory.name: Skarmory
skarmory.flavor: Its sturdy, heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

kingdra.name: Kingdra
kingdra.flavor: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

donphan.name: Donphan
donphan.flavor: Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being hit by a car won't faze this Pokémon. However, it is extremely susceptible to rain.

porygon2.name: Porygon2
porygon2.flavor: This artificial Pokémon evolved thanks to cutting- edge science. It sometimes displays behavior that is not in its programming.

smeargle.name: Smeargle
smeargle.flavor: Once a Smeargle reaches adulthood, it will have other members of its species leave paw prints on its back.

tyrogue.name: Tyrogue
tyrogue.flavor: This earnest Pokémon battles all sorts of opponents, searching for the fighting style that suits it best.

hitmontop.name: Hitmontop
hitmontop.flavor: This Pokémon is adept at dance-like kicks. The horn atop its head is made from the same substance that generally forms fur and claws.

blissey.name: Blissey
blissey.flavor: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey's egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

raikou.name: Raikou
raikou.flavor: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

entei.name: Entei
entei.flavor: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

suicune.name: Suicune
suicune.flavor: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

larvitar.name: Larvitar
larvitar.flavor: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

pupitar.name: Pupitar
pupitar.flavor: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

tyranitar.name: Tyranitar
tyranitar.flavor: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

lugia.name: Lugia
lugia.flavor: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

ho-oh.name: Ho Oh
ho-oh.flavor: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

celebi.name: Celebi
celebi.flavor: This Pokémon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.

grovyle.name: Grovyle
grovyle.flavor: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.

sceptile.name: Sceptile
sceptile.flavor: It agilely flits through the jungle and uses the sharp-edged leaves on its arms to cut down its prey.

combusken.name: Combusken
combusken.flavor: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

blaziken.name: Blaziken
blaziken.flavor: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

marshtomp.name: Marshtomp
marshtomp.flavor: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has served to train its lower body and caused it to develop sturdy legs.

swampert.name: Swampert
swampert.flavor: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break an enormous boulder into pieces.

ludicolo.name: Ludicolo
ludicolo.flavor: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

shiftry.name: Shiftry
shiftry.flavor: It is said that when Shiftry flaps its leafy fans atop ancient trees, chilly winds blow and the season rolls into winter.

gardevoir.name: Gardevoir
gardevoir.flavor: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

breloom.name: Breloom
breloom.flavor: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

slaking.name: Slaking
slaking.flavor: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

ninjask.name: Ninjask
ninjask.flavor: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

loudred.name: Loudred
loudred.flavor: Loudred's ears serve as speakers, and they can put out sound waves powerful enough to blow away a house.

skitty.name: Skitty
skitty.flavor: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in circles, chasing its own tail.

delcatty.name: Delcatty
delcatty.flavor: It is highly popular among Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

aggron.name: Aggron
aggron.flavor: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

electrike.name: Electrike
electrike.flavor: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

manectric.name: Manectric
manectric.flavor: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

swalot.name: Swalot
swalot.flavor: It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.

wailord.name: Wailord
wailord.flavor: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

grumpig.name: Grumpig
grumpig.flavor: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

vibrava.name: Vibrava
vibrava.flavor: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, emitting ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.
