flygon.name: Flygon
flygon.flavor: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

cacturne.name: Cacturne
cacturne.flavor: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

corphish.name: Corphish
corphish.flavor: It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted streams.

crawdaunt.name: Crawdaunt
crawdaunt.flavor: Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all Pokémon that enter its territory with its pincers and throws them out.

lileep.name: Lileep
lileep.flavor: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Lileep once lived in warm seas that existed approximately 100,000,000 years ago.

cradily.name: Cradily
cradily.flavor: It has short legs and can't walk very fast, but its neck and tentacles can extend to over three times their usual length to nab distant prey.

anorith.name: Anorith
anorith.flavor: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.

armaldo.name: Armaldo
armaldo.flavor: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.

milotic.name: Milotic
milotic.flavor: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow- colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

chimecho.name: Chimecho
chimecho.flavor: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

absol.name: Absol
absol.flavor: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

glalie.name: Glalie
glalie.flavor: Its prey is instantaneously frozen stiff by the cold air it exhales from its huge mouth. While they're in that frozen state, it gobbles them up.

walrein.name: Walrein
walrein.flavor: Walrein form herds of 20 to 30 individuals. When a threat appears, the herd's leader will protect the group with its life.

huntail.name: Huntail
huntail.flavor: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

gorebyss.name: Gorebyss
gorebyss.flavor: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.

bagon.name: Bagon
bagon.flavor: Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders. It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

shelgon.name: Shelgon
shelgon.flavor: The cells within its shell transform with explosive speed, preparing it for evolution.

salamence.name: Salamence
salamence.flavor: It flies around on its wings, which have grown in at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames, burning up everything it passes over.

metang.name: Metang
metang.flavor: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

metagross.name: Metagross
metagross.flavor: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

regirock.name: Regirock
regirock.flavor: Every bit of Regirock's body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what's been lost.

regice.name: Regice
regice.flavor: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.

registeel.name: Registeel
registeel.flavor: Registeel's body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.

latias.name: Latias
latias.flavor: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

latios.name: Latios
latios.flavor: It is a highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its forelegs in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

kyogre.name: Kyogre
kyogre.flavor: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

groudon.name: Groudon
groudon.flavor: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

rayquaza.name: Rayquaza
rayquaza.flavor: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

jirachi.name: Jirachi
jirachi.flavor: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near- perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.

deoxys.name: Deoxys
deoxys.flavor: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteorite underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

turtwig.name: Turtwig
turtwig.flavor: The shell on its back is made of soil. If the shell is moist to the touch, Turtwig is very healthy.

grotle.name: Grotle
grotle.flavor: Grotle live in the forest. Each is said to have its own secret place for getting clean springwater.

torterra.name: Torterra
torterra.flavor: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground dwelt a gigantic Torterra.

chimchar.name: Chimchar
chimchar.flavor: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

monferno.name: Monferno
monferno.flavor: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

infernape.name: Infernape
infernape.flavor: This Pokémon confounds opponents with its speed. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

piplup.name: Piplup
piplup.flavor: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

prinplup.name: Prinplup
prinplup.flavor: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees in half with a single hit.

empoleon.name: Empoleon
empoleon.flavor: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them in two with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

roserade.name: Roserade
roserade.flavor: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

cranidos.name: Cranidos
cranidos.flavor: It lived in jungles around a hundred million years ago. It used its skillful headbutts to combat Aerodactyl.

rampardos.name: Rampardos
rampardos.flavor: Stifled by a thick skull that can withstand any impact, this Pokémon's brain never got very big.

shieldon.name: Shieldon
shieldon.flavor: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it has no particular need to battle with others and can spend its time feeding on grass and berries.

bastiodon.name: Bastiodon
bastiodon.flavor: While it can guard against any sort of attack from the front, it is left without recourse when attacked from behind.

wormadam.name: Wormadam
wormadam.flavor: When Burmy evolves, its cloak becomes a part of its body. Wormadam's cloak is never shed.

vespiquen.name: Vespiquen
vespiquen.flavor: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

cherrim.name: Cherrim
cherrim.flavor: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It's full of energy while it's like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

ambipom.name: Ambipom
ambipom.flavor: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

drifblim.name: Drifblim
drifblim.flavor: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

lopunny.name: Lopunny
lopunny.flavor: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

mismagius.name: Mismagius
mismagius.flavor: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

honchkrow.name: Honchkrow
honchkrow.flavor: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

skuntank.name: Skuntank
skuntank.flavor: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

bronzong.name: Bronzong
bronzong.flavor: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

spiritomb.name: Spiritomb
spiritomb.flavor: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

gabite.name: Gabite
gabite.flavor: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.

garchomp.name: Garchomp
garchomp.flavor: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

riolu.name: Riolu
riolu.flavor: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

lucario.name: Lucario
lucario.flavor: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras-even those of foes it could not otherwise see.

hippowdon.name: Hippowdon
hippowdon.flavor: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.

skorupi.name: Skorupi
skorupi.flavor: After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokémon and Sizzlipede share common descent.

drapion.name: Drapion
drapion.flavor: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.

toxicroak.name: Toxicroak
toxicroak.flavor: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

weavile.name: Weavile
weavile.flavor: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

magnezone.name: Magnezone
magnezone.flavor: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

lickilicky.name: Lickilicky
lickilicky.flavor: Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky's tongue can stretch so far.

rhyperior.name: Rhyperior
rhyperior.flavor: This Pokémon's sturdy carapace protects it from volcanic eruptions. It shoots round rocks from the holes in its hands.

tangrowth.name: Tangrowth
tangrowth.flavor: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.

electivire.name: Electivire
electivire.flavor: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

magmortar.name: Magmortar
magmortar.flavor: When shooting 3,600 degree Fahrenheit fireballs from its arms, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

togekiss.name: Togekiss
togekiss.flavor: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.

yanmega.name: Yanmega
yanmega.flavor: Yanmega's wingbeats are so powerful that the Pokémon blows down huge trees nearby when it vigorously launches itself into flight.

leafeon.name: Leafeon
leafeon.flavor: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

glaceon.name: Glaceon
glaceon.flavor: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

gliscor.name: Gliscor
gliscor.flavor: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

mamoswine.name: Mamoswine
mamoswine.flavor: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

porygon-z.name: Porygon Z
porygon-z.flavor: An additional program was installed to create a more advanced Pokémon, but it was apparently flawed. Porygon-Z moves oddly as a result.

gallade.name: Gallade
gallade.flavor: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

probopass.name: Probopass
probopass.flavor: It controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack a foe from three directions.

dusknoir.name: Dusknoir
dusknoir.flavor: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and take them to the afterlife.

froslass.name: Froslass
froslass.flavor: When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become decorations.

rotom.name: Rotom
rotom.flavor: Its electricity-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

uxie.name: Uxie
uxie.flavor: Known as the Being of Knowledge, it is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

mesprit.name: Mesprit
mesprit.flavor: It is known as the Being of Emotion. It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

azelf.name: Azelf
azelf.flavor: It is known as the Being of Willpower. It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

dialga.name: Dialga
dialga.flavor: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

palkia.name: Palkia
palkia.flavor: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

heatran.name: Heatran
heatran.flavor: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

regigigas.name: Regigigas
regigigas.flavor: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

giratina.name: Giratina
giratina.flavor: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

cresselia.name: Cresselia
cresselia.flavor: When it flies, it releases shiny particles from its veil-like wings. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

phione.name: Phione
phione.flavor: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

manaphy.name: Manaphy
manaphy.flavor: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

darkrai.name: Darkrai
darkrai.flavor: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of a new moon.

shaymin.name: Shaymin
shaymin.flavor: It lives in common flower patches but is rarely noticed. It is often mistaken for a flowering plant when curled up.

arceus.name: Arceus
arceus.flavor: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

victini.name: Victini
victini.flavor: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

snivy.name: Snivy
snivy.flavor: The leaf on Snivy's tail generates energy when exposed to sunlight, making Snivy swifter and adding an edge to its moves.

servine.name: Servine
servine.flavor: It runs low to the ground, weaving through the grass, then mercilessly pummels its target by whipping them with its vines.

serperior.name: Serperior
serperior.flavor: It generates energy from sunlight, then amplifies that energy dozens of times within its long body.

tepig.name: Tepig
tepig.flavor: It's more nimble than it looks, and it uses its speed to confound its enemies. It rapidly launches fireballs from both nostrils.

pignite.name: Pignite
pignite.flavor: When Pignite enters battle, its body temperature rapidly soars until Pignite itself is engulfed by a scorching fireball.

emboar.name: Emboar
emboar.flavor: The flames blazing deep inside Emboar's chest erupt vigorously from its chin, forming a beard of fire.

oshawott.name: Oshawott
oshawott.flavor: It wields the scalchop on its stomach like a knife, blocking the moves of its enemies before slashing back at them in swift retaliation.

dewott.name: Dewott
dewott.flavor: It's said that people modeled swordplay after the way Dewott's movements flow like water while it's wielding its two scalchops.

samurott.name: Samurott
samurott.flavor: A master of a sword-drawing art called iaijutsu, Samurott settles its battles with a single swing of either large sword sheathed in its foreleg armor.

herdier.name: Herdier
herdier.flavor: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there's a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.

stoutland.name: Stoutland
stoutland.flavor: These Pokémon seem to enjoy living with humans. Even a Stoutland caught in the wild will warm up to people in about three days.

purrloin.name: Purrloin
purrloin.flavor: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

liepard.name: Liepard
liepard.flavor: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

simisage.name: Simisage
simisage.flavor: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

pansear.name: Pansear
pansear.flavor: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

simisear.name: Simisear
simisear.flavor: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

simipour.name: Simipour
simipour.flavor: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

musharna.name: Musharna
musharna.flavor: When dark mists emanate from its body, don't get too near. If you do, your nightmares will become reality.

zebstrika.name: Zebstrika
zebstrika.flavor: This Pokémon is aggressive and has a volatile disposition. When agitated, it will illuminate its mane in yellow and fire off bolts of electricity.

boldore.name: Boldore
boldore.flavor: If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be wary. It's about to fire off bursts of energy.

gigalith.name: Gigalith
gigalith.flavor: This hardy Pokémon can often be found on construction sites and in mines, working alongside people and Copperajah.

woobat.name: Woobat
woobat.flavor: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.

swoobat.name: Swoobat
swoobat.flavor: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won't be able to fly for a little while.

excadrill.name: Excadrill
excadrill.flavor: Forming a drill with its steel claws and head, it can bore through a steel plate, no matter how thick it is.

audino.name: Audino
audino.flavor: Audino's sense of hearing is superb. Not even a pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape Audino's ears.

timburr.name: Timburr
timburr.flavor: Always carrying squared logs, they help out with construction. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

gurdurr.name: Gurdurr
gurdurr.flavor: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

conkeldurr.name: Conkeldurr
conkeldurr.flavor: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

tympole.name: Tympole
tympole.flavor: Graceful ripples running across the water's surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.

palpitoad.name: Palpitoad
palpitoad.flavor: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.

seismitoad.name: Seismitoad
seismitoad.flavor: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

sewaddle.name: Sewaddle
sewaddle.flavor: Sewaddle chews on leaves to make its clothing. It's trying to mimic the leafy garment Leavanny first dressed it in.

swadloon.name: Swadloon
swadloon.flavor: Swadloon lives quietly at the feet of trees. It prefers eating fallen leaves that have grown soft rather than fresh ones.

leavanny.name: Leavanny
leavanny.flavor: This gentle Pokémon has strong protective instincts. The leaves on its arms are sharp enough to slice a thick tree in half with one stroke.

venipede.name: Venipede
venipede.flavor: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.

whirlipede.name: Whirlipede
whirlipede.flavor: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.

scolipede.name: Scolipede
scolipede.flavor: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws' toxic spikes.

cottonee.name: Cottonee
cottonee.flavor: Pillows and beds stuffed with cotton exhaled by Cottonee are soft and puffy, light and airy- altogether top quality.

whimsicott.name: Whimsicott
whimsicott.flavor: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

petilil.name: Petilil
petilil.flavor: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

lilligant.name: Lilligant
lilligant.flavor: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

basculin.name: Basculin
basculin.flavor: Its temperament is vicious and aggressive. This Pokémon is also full of vitality and can multiply rapidly before anyone notices.

sandile.name: Sandile
sandile.flavor: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

krokorok.name: Krokorok
krokorok.flavor: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

krookodile.name: Krookodile
krookodile.flavor: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

darumaka.name: Darumaka
darumaka.flavor: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

darmanitan.name: Darmanitan
darmanitan.flavor: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.

crustle.name: Crustle
crustle.flavor: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won't come out of its boulder on rainy days.

scrafty.name: Scrafty
scrafty.flavor: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

yamask.name: Yamask
yamask.flavor: It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a mask that's said to have been the face it had when it was still human.

cofagrigus.name: Cofagrigus
cofagrigus.flavor: This Pokémon has a body of sparkling gold. People say it no longer remembers that it was once human.

tirtouga.name: Tirtouga
tirtouga.flavor: This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Although it can only crawl, it still comes up onto land in search of prey.

carracosta.name: Carracosta
carracosta.flavor: Carracosta completely devours its prey—bones, shells, and all. Because of this, Carracosta's own shell grows thick and sturdy.

archen.name: Archen
archen.flavor: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it's very good at jumping.

archeops.name: Archeops
archeops.flavor: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

garbodor.name: Garbodor
garbodor.flavor: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

zorua.name: Zorua
zorua.flavor: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

zoroark.name: Zoroark
zoroark.flavor: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.

cinccino.name: Cinccino
cinccino.flavor: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

gothita.name: Gothita
gothita.flavor: This Pokémon is normally very innocent. When it is staring at something invisible, it is unblinking and utterly silent.

gothorita.name: Gothorita
gothorita.flavor: This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of nights when the starlight is bright.

gothitelle.name: Gothitelle
gothitelle.flavor: Gothitelle unleashes psychic energy and shows opponents dreams of the universe's end. These dreams are apparently ethereal and beautiful.

duosion.name: Duosion
duosion.flavor: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

reuniclus.name: Reuniclus
reuniclus.flavor: Their arms are made of a special liquid. They use psychic power to control these arms and crush boulders.

vanillite.name: Vanillite
vanillite.flavor: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

vanillish.name: Vanillish
vanillish.flavor: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

vanilluxe.name: Vanilluxe
vanilluxe.flavor: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

sawsbuck.name: Sawsbuck
sawsbuck.flavor: It seems that a Sawsbuck with many flowers on its antlers will grow at a slightly slower pace because the flowers absorb the Pokémon's nutrients.

escavalier.name: Escavalier
escavalier.flavor: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

amoonguss.name: Amoonguss
amoonguss.flavor: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss's caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

jellicent.name: Jellicent
jellicent.flavor: Most of this Pokémon's body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair.

galvantula.name: Galvantula
galvantula.flavor: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

ferroseed.name: Ferroseed
ferroseed.flavor: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

ferrothorn.name: Ferrothorn
ferrothorn.flavor: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

klang.name: Klang
klang.flavor: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

klinklang.name: Klinklang
klinklang.flavor: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

eelektrik.name: Eelektrik
eelektrik.flavor: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

eelektross.name: Eelektross
eelektross.flavor: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

beheeyem.name: Beheeyem
beheeyem.flavor: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

chandelure.name: Chandelure
chandelure.flavor: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

axew.name: Axew
axew.flavor: This Pokémon lives in nests that are made in the ground. People in ancient times used its tusks as cooking knives.

fraxure.name: Fraxure
fraxure.flavor: Because its tusks don't grow back once they break, this Pokémon apparently won't use them unless truly necessary.

haxorus.name: Haxorus
haxorus.flavor: This Pokémon nests in caves and abandoned mines. It is docile, but it will become incredibly angry if its tusks are touched, so beware.

beartic.name: Beartic
beartic.flavor: It is a ferocious, carnivorous Pokémon. Once it captures its prey, it will breathe cold air onto the prey to freeze and preserve it.

accelgor.name: Accelgor
accelgor.flavor: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

mienshao.name: Mienshao
mienshao.flavor: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you're in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!

golurk.name: Golurk
golurk.flavor: When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages indiscriminately. During such rampages, it can turn a whole town into a mountain of rubble.

bisharp.name: Bisharp
bisharp.flavor: This Pokémon commands a group of several Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

braviary.name: Braviary
braviary.flavor: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

vullaby.name: Vullaby
vullaby.flavor: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

mandibuzz.name: Mandibuzz
mandibuzz.flavor: It's always searching for food for Vullaby. When it finds a weak Pokémon, Mandibuzz swoops it right off to its nest.

deino.name: Deino
deino.flavor: It can't see, so its first approach to examining things is to bite them. You will be covered in wounds until a Deino warms up to you.

zweilous.name: Zweilous
zweilous.flavor: The two heads do not get along at all. If you don't give each head the same amount of attention, they'll begin fighting out of jealousy.

hydreigon.name: Hydreigon
hydreigon.flavor: Only the central head has a brain. It is very intelligent, but it thinks only of destruction.

volcarona.name: Volcarona
volcarona.flavor: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

cobalion.name: Cobalion
cobalion.flavor: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region's Pokémon.

terrakion.name: Terrakion
terrakion.flavor: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

virizion.name: Virizion
virizion.flavor: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

tornadus.name: Tornadus
tornadus.flavor: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

thundurus.name: Thundurus
thundurus.flavor: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

reshiram.name: Reshiram
reshiram.flavor: Flames spew from its tail as it flies through the sky like a jet airplane. It's said that this Pokémon will scorch the world.

zekrom.name: Zekrom
zekrom.flavor: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

landorus.name: Landorus
landorus.flavor: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

kyurem.name: Kyurem
kyurem.flavor: Dwelling within it is a power even greater than that of Reshiram or Zekrom, but the extreme cold keeps that power bound.

keldeo.name: Keldeo
keldeo.flavor: Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion taught this Pokémon how to fight. It dashes across the world, seeking more opportunities to further its training.

meloetta.name: Meloetta
meloetta.flavor: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

genesect.name: Genesect
genesect.flavor: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

chespin.name: Chespin
chespin.flavor: When Chespin tenses up just before landing a headbutt, the spikes on its head sharpen to points, piercing the enemy's body on contact.

quilladin.name: Quilladin
quilladin.flavor: It's protected by a sturdy shell. The shell is also very heavy, which naturally strengthens Quilladin's lower body.

chesnaught.name: Chesnaught
chesnaught.flavor: When its allies are in trouble, Chesnaught creates a shield with its arms and uses its own body to block attacks.

fennekin.name: Fennekin
fennekin.flavor: This Pokémon gets worked up easily. Its body can also overheat, so it uses its ears to dissipate the heat and calm down.

braixen.name: Braixen
braixen.flavor: It ignites the twig from its tail and waves the twig around to signal its allies. To indicate danger, it draws circles in the air with the twig's flame.

delphox.name: Delphox
delphox.flavor: It leaves burn marks in the ground with the flame at the tip of its wand. Long ago, people used the shapes of these burn marks for divination.

froakie.name: Froakie
froakie.flavor: Its happy-go-lucky look is an act intended to fool its enemies. It will suddenly drop the facade and overwhelm its foes with its blinding speed.

frogadier.name: Frogadier
frogadier.flavor: It excels at devising battle strategies that make use of the terrain, and it never misses its mark when throwing bubble-covered pebbles.

greninja.name: Greninja
greninja.flavor: The movement of air against the long tongue Greninja keeps wrapped around its neck allows it to sense enemies it can't see.

bunnelby.name: Bunnelby
bunnelby.flavor: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

diggersby.name: Diggersby
diggersby.flavor: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

scatterbug.name: Scatterbug
scatterbug.flavor: Any poison this Pokémon takes in is converted into a black powder and secreted. That's why Scatterbug can eat poisonous leaves and roots.

spewpa.name: Spewpa
spewpa.flavor: If Rufflet attacks this Pokémon by pecking at it, it will retaliate with its sharp fur and poisonous black powder.

vivillon.name: Vivillon
vivillon.flavor: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from frigid lands.

litleo.name: Litleo
litleo.flavor: When Litleo are young, female Pyroar will teach them how to hunt. Once the Litleo mature, they will leave the pride and set out on their own.

pyroar.name: Pyroar
pyroar.flavor: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It's thanks to them that their pride doesn't starve.

flabebe.name: Flabebe
flabebe.flavor: This Pokémon can draw forth the power hidden within blooming wild flowers. It is particularly fond of red flowers.

floette.name: Floette
floette.flavor: This Pokémon draws forth what power is left in withered flowers to make them healthy again. It holds a red flower.

florges.name: Florges
florges.flavor: This Pokémon creates an impressive flower garden in its territory. It draws forth the power of the red flowers around its neck.

skiddo.name: Skiddo
skiddo.flavor: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the backs of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.

gogoat.name: Gogoat
gogoat.flavor: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

pancham.name: Pancham
pancham.flavor: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master's actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.

pangoro.name: Pangoro
pangoro.flavor: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

furfrou.name: Furfrou
furfrou.flavor: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

espurr.name: Espurr
espurr.flavor: It keeps its ears covered to prevent the intense psychic power in its body from escaping, but it falls unconscious if this power builds too much.

meowstic.name: Meowstic
meowstic.flavor: Though it has enough psychic power to blast away any opponent, Meowstic prefers to support its allies rather than attack.

honedge.name: Honedge
honedge.flavor: Honedge's soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge's body.

doublade.name: Doublade
doublade.flavor: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

aegislash.name: Aegislash
aegislash.flavor: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

spritzee.name: Spritzee
spritzee.flavor: A scent pouch within this Pokémon's body allows it to create various scents. A change in its diet will alter the fragrance it produces.

aromatisse.name: Aromatisse
aromatisse.flavor: The scent that constantly emits from its fur is so powerful that this Pokémon's companions will eventually lose their sense of smell.

swirlix.name: Swirlix
swirlix.flavor: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

slurpuff.name: Slurpuff
slurpuff.flavor: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

inkay.name: Inkay
inkay.flavor: It protects itself from tough foes by flashing its luminescent spots to discourage them.

malamar.name: Malamar
malamar.flavor: Its hypnotic powers are dangerously strong. Anyone who falls under Malamar's control loses their memories surrounding the event.

binacle.name: Binacle
binacle.flavor: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

barbaracle.name: Barbaracle
barbaracle.flavor: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

dragalge.name: Dragalge
dragalge.flavor: Using a liquid poison, Dragalge indiscriminately attacks anything that wanders into its territory. This poison can corrode the undersides of boats.

clawitzer.name: Clawitzer
clawitzer.flavor: Clawitzer can move through the water at a speed of 60 knots by using gas inside its body to expel water from the back of its claw.

heliolisk.name: Heliolisk
heliolisk.flavor: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

tyrunt.name: Tyrunt
tyrunt.flavor: This is an ancient Pokémon, revived in modern times. It has a violent disposition, and it'll tear apart anything it gets between its hefty jaws.

tyrantrum.name: Tyrantrum
tyrantrum.flavor: This Pokémon is from about 100,000,000 years ago. It has the presence of a king, vicious but magnificent.

amaura.name: Amaura
amaura.flavor: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. In the past, it lived with others of its kind in cold lands where there were fewer predators.

aurorus.name: Aurorus
aurorus.flavor: Aurorus was restored from a fossil. It's said that when this Pokémon howls, auroras appear in the night sky.

sylveon.name: Sylveon
sylveon.flavor: This Pokémon uses its ribbonlike feelers to send a soothing aura into its opponents, erasing their hostility.

hawlucha.name: Hawlucha
hawlucha.flavor: Its elegant finishing moves-performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings-are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

carbink.name: Carbink
carbink.flavor: It has slept underground for hundreds of millions of years since its birth. It's occasionally found during the excavation of caves.

goomy.name: Goomy
goomy.flavor: Most of a Goomy's body is water. A membrane covers the whole Pokémon to prevent it from shriveling up in dry weather.

sliggoo.name: Sliggoo
sliggoo.flavor: The swirly protrusion on its back is filled with all its vital organs, such as its brain and heart.

goodra.name: Goodra
goodra.flavor: It loves the rain. This mellow Pokémon can be seen walking around on the plains and in the mountains on rainy days.

phantump.name: Phantump
phantump.flavor: Legend tells that its green leaves can cure any illness. When plucked, however, the leaves will instantly wither away.

trevenant.name: Trevenant
trevenant.flavor: Using its roots, Trevenant connects itself to trees and monitors every corner of its forest. It uses curses to drive intruders away.

pumpkaboo.name: Pumpkaboo
pumpkaboo.flavor: Spirits that wander this world are placed into Pumpkaboo's body. They're then moved on to the afterlife.

gourgeist.name: Gourgeist
gourgeist.flavor: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

avalugg.name: Avalugg
avalugg.flavor: As Avalugg walks along with Bergmite on its back, it comes across pods of Cetitan. It lets them pass to avoid conflict.

noibat.name: Noibat
noibat.flavor: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

noivern.name: Noivern
noivern.flavor: Ultrasonic waves emitted by a Noivern can pulverize a large boulder. This Pokémon has a cruel disposition.

xerneas.name: Xerneas
xerneas.flavor: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

yveltal.name: Yveltal
yveltal.flavor: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

zygarde.name: Zygarde
zygarde.flavor: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

diancie.name: Diancie
diancie.flavor: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

hoopa.name: Hoopa
hoopa.flavor: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

volcanion.name: Volcanion
volcanion.flavor: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

dartrix.name: Dartrix
dartrix.flavor: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it may stop listening to you.

decidueye.name: Decidueye
decidueye.flavor: It cunningly conceals arrow quills in its wings. It launches these quills with such precision that they can pierce a pebble at over a hundred yards.

torracat.name: Torracat
torracat.flavor: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever fire spews out.

incineroar.name: Incineroar
incineroar.flavor: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.

brionne.name: Brionne
brionne.flavor: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, then briskly bombards its enemies.

primarina.name: Primarina
primarina.flavor: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.

vikavolt.name: Vikavolt
vikavolt.flavor: Displaying exceptional mobility, it weaves between trees and shoots down bird Pokémon with its electromagnetic beams.

crabominable.name: Crabominable
crabominable.flavor: The detached pincers of these Pokémon are delicious. Some Trainers bring Lechonk into the mountains just to search for them.

oricorio.name: Oricorio
oricorio.flavor: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.

ribombee.name: Ribombee
ribombee.flavor: Ribombee can sense when people or Pokémon are feeling down, and it will cheer them up with handmade pollen puffs.

rockruff.name: Rockruff
rockruff.flavor: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

lycanroc.name: Lycanroc
lycanroc.flavor: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.

wishiwashi.name: Wishiwashi
wishiwashi.flavor: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

toxapex.name: Toxapex
toxapex.flavor: This Pokémon lives within a dome made by its own legs. Toxapex monitors its surroundings by sensing the flow of the tide through its spikes.

mudsdale.name: Mudsdale
mudsdale.flavor: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.

araquanid.name: Araquanid
araquanid.flavor: A caring Pokémon, Araquanid carries Dewpider around inside its water bubble to protect them as it walks. It protects its food in its bubble too.

lurantis.name: Lurantis
lurantis.flavor: By masquerading as a bug Pokémon, it lowers the guard of actual bug Pokémon lured in by a scent of sweet flowers. Its sickles bring them down.

steenee.name: Steenee
steenee.flavor: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

tsareena.name: Tsareena
tsareena.flavor: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

comfey.name: Comfey
comfey.flavor: It uses its vine to pick flowers. The flowers that Comfey attaches to itself develop healing properties.

golisopod.name: Golisopod
golisopod.flavor: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

palossand.name: Palossand
palossand.flavor: The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

type-null.name: Type Null
type-null.flavor: Rumor has it that the theft of top-secret research notes led to a new instance of this Pokémon being created in the Galar region.

silvally.name: Silvally
silvally.flavor: A solid bond of trust between this Pokémon and its Trainer awakened the strength hidden within Silvally. It can change its type at will.

minior.name: Minior
minior.flavor: This Pokémon is born in the ozone layer. It falls to the ground once the outer shell enclosing its core grows heavy.

mimikyu.name: Mimikyu
mimikyu.flavor: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

hakamo-o.name: Hakamo O
hakamo-o.flavor: It gets into fistfights so intense that the scales on its arms peel off. Bare arms are a sign of valiance.

kommo-o.name: Kommo O
kommo-o.flavor: It lets its arm hang, and then-quick as a flash- swings upward to land its specialty punch and send the opponent flying high into the sky.

cosmog.name: Cosmog
cosmog.flavor: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

cosmoem.name: Cosmoem
cosmoem.flavor: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon's growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

solgaleo.name: Solgaleo
solgaleo.flavor: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.

lunala.name: Lunala
lunala.flavor: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

nihilego.name: Nihilego
nihilego.flavor: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

buzzwole.name: Buzzwole
buzzwole.flavor: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

pheromosa.name: Pheromosa
pheromosa.flavor: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

xurkitree.name: Xurkitree
xurkitree.flavor: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

celesteela.name: Celesteela
celesteela.flavor: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

kartana.name: Kartana
kartana.flavor: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

guzzlord.name: Guzzlord
guzzlord.flavor: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It's one of the Ultra Beasts.

necrozma.name: Necrozma
necrozma.flavor: It survives by absorbing light. After a long time spent slumbering underground, impurities accumulated within it, causing its body to darken.

magearna.name: Magearna
magearna.flavor: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

marshadow.name: Marshadow
marshadow.flavor: By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokémon learned the ultimate techniques.

poipole.name: Poipole
poipole.flavor: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

naganadel.name: Naganadel
naganadel.flavor: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

stakataka.name: Stakataka
stakataka.flavor: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

blacephalon.name: Blacephalon
blacephalon.flavor: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

zeraora.name: Zeraora
zeraora.flavor: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

meltan.name: Meltan
meltan.flavor: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

melmetal.name: Melmetal
melmetal.flavor: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

grookey.name: Grookey
grookey.flavor: The stick Grookey holds has grown harder and more flexible after soaking in the energy that emanates from inside Grookey's body.

thwackey.name: Thwackey
thwackey.flavor: It skillfully uses its two sticks not only for drumming out rapid beats but also for pummeling opponents during battle.

rillaboom.name: Rillaboom
rillaboom.flavor: Though it has a calm disposition, it won't tolerate those who drum up discord. It strictly disciplines offenders until they learn their lesson.

scorbunny.name: Scorbunny
scorbunny.flavor: Once its body has heated up, Scorbunny can use the full extent of its power. That's why it does warm-up exercises.

raboot.name: Raboot
raboot.flavor: Thanks to its soft and fluffy fur, Raboot can easily heat up its fire energy and produce flames with more power.

cinderace.name: Cinderace
cinderace.flavor: Although Cinderace loses its cool easily, it will battle flawlessly for a Trainer it trusts.

sobble.name: Sobble
sobble.flavor: It gets berries to eat by shooting them down with bullets of water it spurts from its mouth. Its aim is perfect.

drizzile.name: Drizzile
drizzile.flavor: It extends its long, slimy tongue at blinding speeds and finishes off its prey with great skill.

inteleon.name: Inteleon
inteleon.flavor: It uses special lenses in its eyes to sense things about its opponents-like their body heat-then attacks once it identifies a weak spot.

rookidee.name: Rookidee
rookidee.flavor: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

corvisquire.name: Corvisquire
corvisquire.flavor: It's said that the reason behind Corvisquire's high level of intelligence is the large size of its brain relative to those of other bird Pokémon.

corviknight.name: Corviknight
corviknight.flavor: Corviknight can't serve as a taxi service in Paldea because the Pokémon's natural predators will attack it while it flies, endangering the customer.

blipbug.name: Blipbug
blipbug.flavor: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

dottler.name: Dottler
dottler.flavor: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

orbeetle.name: Orbeetle
orbeetle.flavor: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

thievul.name: Thievul
thievul.flavor: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

gossifleur.name: Gossifleur
gossifleur.flavor: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

eldegoss.name: Eldegoss
eldegoss.flavor: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

wooloo.name: Wooloo
wooloo.flavor: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

dubwool.name: Dubwool
dubwool.flavor: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

chewtle.name: Chewtle
chewtle.flavor: Its large front tooth is still growing in. When the tooth itches, this Pokémon will bite another Chewtle's horn, and the two Pokémon will tussle.

drednaw.name: Drednaw
drednaw.flavor: Its massive, jagged teeth can crush a boulder in a single bite. This Pokémon has an extremely vicious disposition.

yamper.name: Yamper
yamper.flavor: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

boltund.name: Boltund
boltund.flavor: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

rolycoly.name: Rolycoly
rolycoly.flavor: On sunny days, Rolycoly will come out onto grassy plains and roll around. Then it will eat the grass that gets tangled in its wheel-like leg.

carkol.name: Carkol
carkol.flavor: The temperature inside its body increases when it experiences strong emotions. It rolls around frantically while spewing flames.

coalossal.name: Coalossal
coalossal.flavor: To intimidate its opponents, Coalossal will vigorously shake its body, scattering coal from its smoldering back.

applin.name: Applin
applin.flavor: It grows by eating the flesh of an apple. Applin uses its own body fluid to strengthen the apple's skin and prevent it from rotting.

flapple.name: Flapple
flapple.flavor: It flutters around while seeking an opening in the opponent's guard, then attacks by spitting acidic liquid strong enough to melt metal.

appletun.name: Appletun
appletun.flavor: It feeds mainly on sweet apples. It will also eat small bug Pokémon that are attracted by its sweet nectar.

sandaconda.name: Sandaconda
sandaconda.flavor: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

barraskewda.name: Barraskewda
barraskewda.flavor: It spins its tail fins to leap from the water, then viciously bites down on Wingull flying close to the water's surface.

toxel.name: Toxel
toxel.flavor: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

toxtricity.name: Toxtricity
toxtricity.flavor: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

sizzlipede.name: Sizzlipede
sizzlipede.flavor: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

centiskorch.name: Centiskorch
centiskorch.flavor: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

clobbopus.name: Clobbopus
clobbopus.flavor: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

grapploct.name: Grapploct
grapploct.flavor: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

polteageist.name: Polteageist
polteageist.flavor: The tea that composes Polteageist's body has a distinct and enjoyable flavor. Drinking too much, however, can be fatal.

hatenna.name: Hatenna
hatenna.flavor: Because the emotions of others constantly flow into its head, this Pokémon prefers environments where no other creatures live.

hattrem.name: Hattrem
hattrem.flavor: To this Pokémon, strong emotions apparently feel like incredibly loud noises-even if the emotions are happy ones.

hatterene.name: Hatterene
hatterene.flavor: Hatterene knocks out those that intrude in its home forest by blasting them with a beam, then slashing with claws enhanced by psychic power.

impidimp.name: Impidimp
impidimp.flavor: The reason this Pokémon causes trouble for those it feels close to is because Impidimp itself gets irritable if it can't absorb negative emotions.

morgrem.name: Morgrem
morgrem.flavor: Morgrem prefers dirty tactics, like ambushing, because it doesn't have confidence in its brawn.

grimmsnarl.name: Grimmsnarl
grimmsnarl.flavor: This Pokémon has complete control over its hair. Grimmsnarl normally keeps its hair wrapped around its body to support its muscles.

obstagoon.name: Obstagoon
obstagoon.flavor: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

perrserker.name: Perrserker
perrserker.flavor: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cursola.name: Cursola
cursola.flavor: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

sirfetchd.name: Sirfetchd
sirfetchd.flavor: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

mr-rime.name: Mr Rime
mr-rime.flavor: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

runerigus.name: Runerigus
runerigus.flavor: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

milcery.name: Milcery
milcery.flavor: The more sweet aromas it absorbs, the more its body swells. Milcery will deflate when its energy level drops.

alcremie.name: Alcremie
alcremie.flavor: Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring happiness to all who eat them.

pincurchin.name: Pincurchin
pincurchin.flavor: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

snom.name: Snom
snom.flavor: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.

frosmoth.name: Frosmoth
frosmoth.flavor: Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae. It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making them fall like snow.

stonjourner.name: Stonjourner
stonjourner.flavor: The elemental composition of the rocks that form its body were found to match the bedrock of a land far away from this Pokémon's habitat.

eiscue.name: Eiscue
eiscue.flavor: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.

indeedee.name: Indeedee
indeedee.flavor: This Pokémon picks up on the positive emotions of other creatures via its horns and uses those emotions to fuel itself.

morpeko.name: Morpeko
morpeko.flavor: Morpeko eats seeds constantly to keep its hunger at bay. If it's hungry for too long, it grows wild and brutish.

copperajah.name: Copperajah
copperajah.flavor: This Pokémon was brought to Paldea long ago by people from a faraway land. It's so strong that it can easily pull an airplane.

dracozolt.name: Dracozolt
dracozolt.flavor: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

arctozolt.name: Arctozolt
arctozolt.flavor: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

dracovish.name: Dracovish
dracovish.flavor: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

arctovish.name: Arctovish
arctovish.flavor: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

drakloak.name: Drakloak
drakloak.flavor: This Pokémon flies around at over 120 miles per hour. If a Drakloak is defeated in a battle, its Dreepy will wander off without a second thought.

dragapult.name: Dragapult
dragapult.flavor: Dragapult can make its whole body transparent by clearing its mind and focusing. Even the Dreepy in Dragapult's horns become invisible.

zacian.name: Zacian
zacian.flavor: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

zamazenta.name: Zamazenta
zamazenta.flavor: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

eternatus.name: Eternatus
eternatus.flavor: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

kubfu.name: Kubfu
kubfu.flavor: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

urshifu.name: Urshifu
urshifu.flavor: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

regieleki.name: Regieleki
regieleki.flavor: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

regidrago.name: Regidrago
regidrago.flavor: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

glastrier.name: Glastrier
glastrier.flavor: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

spectrier.name: Spectrier
spectrier.flavor: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

calyrex.name: Calyrex
calyrex.flavor: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

wyrdeer.name: Wyrdeer
wyrdeer.flavor: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

kleavor.name: Kleavor
kleavor.flavor: Parts of its body turned to stone when it evolved thanks to an extremely rare ore found in volcanic areas.

ursaluna.name: Ursaluna
ursaluna.flavor: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

basculegion.name: Basculegion
basculegion.flavor: This Pokémon is cloaked in the souls of its comrades who perished during a punishing journey to the river of their birth.

sneasler.name: Sneasler
sneasler.flavor: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

overqwil.name: Overqwil
overqwil.flavor: Overqwil's poisonous spikes will reflexively react even while Overqwil sleeps, stabbing any moving thing that approaches.

enamorus.name: Enamorus
enamorus.flavor: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

sprigatito.name: Sprigatito
sprigatito.flavor: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

floragato.name: Floragato
floragato.flavor: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

meowscarada.name: Meowscarada
meowscarada.flavor: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

fuecoco.name: Fuecoco
fuecoco.flavor: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

crocalor.name: Crocalor
crocalor.flavor: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

skeledirge.name: Skeledirge
skeledirge.flavor: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge's head gained a soul.

quaxly.name: Quaxly
quaxly.flavor: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

quaxwell.name: Quaxwell
quaxwell.flavor: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

quaquaval.name: Quaquaval
quaquaval.flavor: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

lechonk.name: Lechonk
lechonk.flavor: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

oinkologne.name: Oinkologne
oinkologne.flavor: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

spidops.name: Spidops
spidops.flavor: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

nymble.name: Nymble
nymble.flavor: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

lokix.name: Lokix
lokix.flavor: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

pawmo.name: Pawmo
pawmo.flavor: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

pawmot.name: Pawmot
pawmot.flavor: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

tandemaus.name: Tandemaus
tandemaus.flavor: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

maushold.name: Maushold
maushold.flavor: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

fidough.name: Fidough
fidough.flavor: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

dachsbun.name: Dachsbun
dachsbun.flavor: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

smoliv.name: Smoliv
smoliv.flavor: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

dolliv.name: Dolliv
dolliv.flavor: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

arboliva.name: Arboliva
arboliva.flavor: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

squawkabilly.name: Squawkabilly
squawkabilly.flavor: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.

naclstack.name: Naclstack
naclstack.flavor: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

garganacl.name: Garganacl
garganacl.flavor: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

armarouge.name: Armarouge
armarouge.flavor: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

ceruledge.name: Ceruledge
ceruledge.flavor: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

tadbulb.name: Tadbulb
tadbulb.flavor: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

bellibolt.name: Bellibolt
bellibolt.flavor: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

mabosstiff.name: Mabosstiff
mabosstiff.flavor: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

grafaiai.name: Grafaiai
grafaiai.flavor: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

brambleghast.name: Brambleghast
brambleghast.flavor: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

klawf.name: Klawf
klawf.flavor: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

capsakid.name: Capsakid
capsakid.flavor: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

scovillain.name: Scovillain
scovillain.flavor: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

rellor.name: Rellor
rellor.flavor: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

rabsca.name: Rabsca
rabsca.flavor: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

espathra.name: Espathra
espathra.flavor: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

tinkatuff.name: Tinkatuff
tinkatuff.flavor: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

tinkaton.name: Tinkaton
tinkaton.flavor: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

wugtrio.name: Wugtrio
wugtrio.flavor: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

bombirdier.name: Bombirdier
bombirdier.flavor: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon's chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

finizen.name: Finizen
finizen.flavor: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

palafin.name: Palafin
palafin.flavor: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

varoom.name: Varoom
varoom.flavor: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

revavroom.name: Revavroom
revavroom.flavor: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders- now numbering eight-to generate energy.

cyclizar.name: Cyclizar
cyclizar.flavor: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

orthworm.name: Orthworm
orthworm.flavor: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

glimmora.name: Glimmora
glimmora.flavor: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

houndstone.name: Houndstone
houndstone.flavor: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

flamigo.name: Flamigo
flamigo.flavor: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

tatsugiri.name: Tatsugiri
tatsugiri.flavor: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

annihilape.name: Annihilape
annihilape.flavor: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

clodsire.name: Clodsire
clodsire.flavor: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It's a risky move that puts everything on the line.

farigiraf.name: Farigiraf
farigiraf.flavor: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

dudunsparce.name: Dudunsparce
dudunsparce.flavor: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

kingambit.name: Kingambit
kingambit.flavor: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

great-tusk.name: Great Tusk
great-tusk.flavor: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

scream-tail.name: Scream Tail
scream-tail.flavor: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

brute-bonnet.name: Brute Bonnet
brute-bonnet.flavor: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

flutter-mane.name: Flutter Mane
flutter-mane.flavor: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

slither-wing.name: Slither Wing
slither-wing.flavor: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

sandy-shocks.name: Sandy Shocks
sandy-shocks.flavor: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

iron-treads.name: Iron Treads
iron-treads.flavor: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.

iron-bundle.name: Iron Bundle
iron-bundle.flavor: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

iron-hands.name: Iron Hands
iron-hands.flavor: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

iron-jugulis.name: Iron Jugulis
iron-jugulis.flavor: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

iron-moth.name: Iron Moth
iron-moth.flavor: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.

iron-thorns.name: Iron Thorns
iron-thorns.flavor: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

arctibax.name: Arctibax
arctibax.flavor: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

baxcalibur.name: Baxcalibur
baxcalibur.flavor: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

gimmighoul.name: Gimmighoul
gimmighoul.flavor: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

gholdengo.name: Gholdengo
gholdengo.flavor: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.

wo-chien.name: Wo Chien
wo-chien.flavor: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king's evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

chien-pao.name: Chien Pao
chien-pao.flavor: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

ting-lu.name: Ting Lu
ting-lu.flavor: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.

chi-yu.name: Chi Yu
chi-yu.flavor: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

roaring-moon.name: Roaring Moon
roaring-moon.flavor: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

iron-valiant.name: Iron Valiant
iron-valiant.flavor: It has some similarities to a mad scientist's invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

koraidon.name: Koraidon
koraidon.flavor: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

miraidon.name: Miraidon
miraidon.flavor: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

walking-wake.name: Walking Wake
walking-wake.flavor: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.

iron-leaves.name: Iron Leaves
iron-leaves.flavor: Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.

dipplin.name: Dipplin
dipplin.flavor: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

poltchageist.name: Poltchageist
poltchageist.flavor: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

sinistcha.name: Sinistcha
sinistcha.flavor: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

okidogi.name: Okidogi
okidogi.flavor: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

munkidori.name: Munkidori
